sections.sectionTitle: Strengthen Your Security with CrowdStrike Falcon Solutions
sections.intro: Adopt CrowdStrike Falcon solutions distributed by Victrix. CrowdStrikes provides cloud-native protection that secures your entire attack surface: endpoints, identities, cloud workloads, observability, and security operations.

items.title: Endpoint Protection (EDR/XDR)
items.text:
Strengthen endpoint security with real-time threat detection.

CrowdStrike Falcon Prevent and Falcon Insights XDR unify prevention, EDR and XDR, in a cloud-native architecture that monitors, analyzes, and blocks advanced attacks.

Result: faster detection and response, and attacks stopped before impact.

items.title: Threat Intelligence
items.text:
Stay ahead of attackers with continuous visibility and proactive threat hunting.

CrowdStrike Falcon Adversary OverWatch brings together threat intelligence, behavioural analytics, and human-led threat hunting to identify malicious activity before it unfolds.

Result: greater visibility into adversaries and more targeted prevention of advanced intrusions.

items.title: Cloud Security Posture
items.text:
Protect your cloud environments with unified 24/7 security.

CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security safeguards cloud workloads, assesses the posture of public cloud environments, and prevents risky configuration across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.

Result: consistent cloud protection and a measurable reduction of your attack surface.

items.title: Identity Security (IAM)
items.text:
Stop identity-based attacks before exploitation.

CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen Identity Security detects credential abuse, monitors access, and blocks lateral movements based on identity compromise.

Result: fewer account takeovers and stronger protection against targeted attacks.

items.title: Observability (SIEM)
items.text:
Gain full visibility by unifying logs and alerts.

CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM centralizes data, correlates events, and provides real-time analytics to accelerate investigations.

Result: faster investigations, less operational noise, and better decision-making.

items.title: Managed Services (MDR)
items.text:
Accelerate defence with 24/7 monitoring and guided response.

CrowdStrike Falcon Complete Next-Gen MDR combines MDR expertise, threat hunting, and active remediation to neutralize attacks without relying on internal resources.

Result: continuous operational security, reduced team pressure, and a more reslient posture.
